description: This source file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Ra, which wraps and extends the SVN::Ra module for use by git-svn. It includes functions for authentication setup, repository interactions (like get_dir, get_log, check_path), reparenting, switching, and cache management. The file contains class methods, internal utility functions, and some version compatibility logic tailored for interacting with Subversion repositories within git-svn.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl class extending SVN::Ra, providing customized methods for git-svn operations including repository info caching, directory listing, log retrieval, switching, reparenting, and compatibility handling.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Git::SVN::Ra instance for the given URL, handling canonicalization and repository setup.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks the existence and type of a path in the repository, utilizing caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries at a given path and revision, with caching and compatibility handling.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Fetches commit logs with support for path prefixing, revision limits, and adaptable parameters for SVN version differences.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Compares directory trees between two URLs at specific revisions, used for verification in earlier SVN versions.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Returns a commit editor object, handling SVN version compatibility.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs a repository update, optionally unlinking index files and setting update paths.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs a switch operation to change the repository URL for a working copy, with reparenting support.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Computes the longest common directory prefix among a set of Git::SVN objects and optionally glob patterns.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Performs batch fetching of revisions and commits within a revision range, updating index states and handling repository reloads as needed.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively retrieves directory entries up to a specified depth, for globbing subdirectories.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Converts the repository URL to a shorter form relative to the repository root if possible.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Checks whether the SVN server supports the do_switch operation by attempting a test switch.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN errors related to missing revisions or branches, ignoring expected errors and warning about retries.
